question: limits[].kind has no term for a minimum billed storage duration (an object deleted early is billed for the full minimum, nothing is deleted); retention-clamped means data is deleted after a period. Should the vocabulary gain a term such as min-billed-duration?
why: Tigris bills 30 days minimum on Infrequent Access and 90 days on Archive and Archive Instant Retrieval; the record carries it in limits_note only, because no kind fits
